note: Three independent lifecycle emails. Each belongs to a DIFFERENT campaign/flow — do not bundle them into one sequence.

emails.placement: Standalone flow. Entry: contact asked to be reminded after a screener result of 'too young'. Send once, then exit.
emails.delay: fires when the pet crosses 12 months (evaluate daily)
emails.send_limit: exactly one send per contact, ever
emails.subject: Your bean is old enough now
emails.preheader: You screened a puppy and we said not yet. Twelve months on, it is worth running again.
emails.suppression: exclude anyone who has since placed an order or re-run the screener

emails.placement: First and only email of the abandoned-checkout flow. If the client wants a second touch, duplicate and change the subject only.
emails.send_limit: one per abandoned checkout, max one per contact per 14 days
emails.subject: Your box is still packed
emails.preheader: Your cart is saved and checkout picks up exactly where you stopped.
emails.line_items: The row marked <!-- REPEAT this row per line item --> loops over cart items; the subtotal row stays outside the loop.

emails.placement: Email 1 of the welcome flow — the code delivery. Existing emails/01-welcome.html through 04-ready.html follow as the education series; this one replaces nothing, it precedes them.
emails.trigger: hb:subscribe event from the Email Capture Popup (see popup_handoff/)
emails.delay: immediate — the user is waiting for this code
emails.send_limit: one per signup; resend on request
emails.subject: Here’s your 10% off
emails.preheader: Your code works on any box, subscription or one-time order.
emails.requirements: discount_code must be unique per contact, single-use, 10% off, no product restriction, valid on subscriptions

type.headline: DM Sans 700, 38-40px / 40-42px, letter-spacing -0.042em
type.label: DM Mono 400-500, 9.5-11px, letter-spacing 0.16-0.22em, uppercase
type.fallbacks: DM Sans -> Arial/Helvetica; DM Mono -> Courier New. Outlook is forced to Arial via an mso conditional.
